title: This run: three-quarter bodies, head turnarounds, first expression pages
summary: Everything made on 2026-11-09 up to the ChatGPT limit: a three-quarter body sheet for every locked sheet, head turnarounds for the villains, walk-ons, partners and Hollows, and Krell's first two expression pages. Each passed Claude's review except Sela's mark and Tull's head (both explained on their cards). Tap any picture to see it full size.
